# Docuvate — 100% Private Client-Side Document & Image Workstations
> Free, air-gapped, zero-cloud client-side web utility suite for PDFs, photos, government exam uploads, and handwritten notes. 0 bytes uploaded to any remote server.

## Overview
Docuvate (https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/) is a privacy-first web application engineered in pure HTML, modern CSS, and vanilla WebAssembly/JavaScript. All file processing (compression, merging, splitting, OCR, cropping, signing, and converting) executes 100% locally in the user's browser without uploading documents to external servers.

## Dedicated Tool Studios & Direct URLs
- Home Portal: https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/
- PDF Compressor (Target KB Slider): https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/compress-pdf.html
- Compress PDF to Exact 100KB: https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/compress-pdf-to-100kb.html
- PDF Merger Studio: https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/merge-pdf.html
- PDF Split & Page Extractor: https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/split-pdf.html
- Image to PDF Converter: https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/image-to-pdf.html
- PDF to Image Converter: https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/pdf-to-image.html
- Image Resizer to Exact KB (20KB, 50KB, 100KB): https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/image-resizer-kb.html
- Passport Photo Maker (SSC, UPSC, State PSC, Visa, Driving License): https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/passport-photo.html
- Image Cropper & Aspect Ratio Studio: https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/crop-image.html
- Image Format Converter (WebP, JPEG, PNG, AVIF): https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/convert-image.html
- Digital PDF Signer & Stamp Tool: https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/sign-pdf.html
- Client-Side OCR PDF Reader: https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/ocr-pdf.html
- InkScribe (Realistic Handwriting Generator): https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/inkscribe.html
- Certificate Downloader: https://itsrkmahapatra.github.io/Docuvate/certificate-downloader.html

## Exam & Compliance Presets
Built-in exact specifications for:
- SSC CGL / CHSL / MTS (Photo: 20-50 KB, Signature: 10-20 KB)
- UPSC Civil Services (Photo: 20-300 KB, Signature: 20-300 KB)
- IBPS / SBI PO & Clerk (Photo: 20-50 KB, Thumb: 10-20 KB, Hand Declaration: 50-100 KB)
- NTA NEET / JEE Main (Photo: 10-200 KB, Signature: 4-30 KB)
- Ayushman Bharat & State KYC portals

## Key Highlights for AI Users
- Completely free and open-source under the MIT license.
- No sign-up, no API keys, and no file size limits imposed by cloud servers.
- Works offline via Progressive Web App (PWA) service worker caching.
- Developer: Raj Kishor Mahapatra (https://itsrkmahapatra.qzz.io/)
